profile.headline: Passionate Full-Stack Software Engineer (JavaScript/TypeScript/React/Node/Next)
profile.summary: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience leading scalable, customer-focused web platforms using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS, driving measurable business impact through cross-functional leadership and production-grade delivery.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Long Beach, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
>As a Tech Lead, made substantial contributions and collaborated with cross-functional remote teams to successfully deliver a highly anticipated project, Annual Membership (Shopify, Prismic, Next/Node, Optimizely, Segment, Iterable, Java API, & Localization).
>Successfully delivered a high-value project, under tight time constraints, spanning 5+ cross-functional teams, from concept to product launch, while collaborating with multiple teams to define requirements and co-developing a real-time map using Leaflet.js and RESTful API to track player positions
>Significantly contributed to team growth and productivity by mentoring junior developers, actively participating in the hiring process, facilitating knowledge transfer through tech presentations, collaborating with peers to capture high-level architecture, and championing proposals like engineering ownership to enhance productivity
>Enhanced software development processes by revamping unit test architecture for improved reusability, refining the PR review process through template enhancements, and optimizing bundle size to boost performance, all contributing to increased efficiency and code quality
>Streamlined Zwift's User Club functionality by implementing Create, Edit, and Config features, resulting in reduced workload for Zwift Support staff.
>Pioneered the development and implementation of a modular and reusable form components library using Reactstrap.js for Profile Settings, significantly reducing the effort to create new forms and ensuring a higher level of style consistency
>Elevated user experience by enhancing Shopify's functionality with new features and UI updates, ensuring seamless alignment with the web experience
>Adapted to an unfamiliar role to support the team's commitment during a resource shortage and played a key role in the development of the Club Search & Filter functionality, specifically by implementing the filter fragment for club search using Kotlin
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Web Technologies · Node.js · React.js · Leaflet.js · Next.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · REST API · Localization · Optimizely · Datadog · Shopify · Prismic CMS · WordPress · PagerDuty · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Bootstrap (Framework) · Angular · SASS · Jest · Github · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon S3 · Amazon Route 53 · Amazon CloudFront · Terraform · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Mentoring · Data Structures · Redis · Keycloak

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
> Led the development of the high-value Procure to Pay project, which streamlined four separate forms into a single automated form, integrated with Oracle using JavaScript & RESTful API for enhanced data reliability, and implemented a robust workflow with automated task generation and assignment.
> Adhered to Agile Scrum methodology for continuous development and deployment, ensuring a 99% uptime for the corporate platform and its tools, including the customer-facing Service Portal built with AngularJS.
> Led teams in successfully recovering non-production instances during a high-pressure corporate merger, ensuring uninterrupted operations.
> Collaborated with development peers to design, develop, test, deploy, integrate, and maintain robust, efficient, and scalable solutions, fostering streamlined workflows.
> Innovatively designed and implemented reusable custom directives in AngularJS to enhance the user experience, displaying ticket statuses and details dynamically.
> Developed and deployed reusable APIs for efficient data retrieval and calculated result delivery, optimizing cross-process functionality and data consistency.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering · ServiceNow · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · REST API · Scaled Agile Framework · Agile Methodologies · Scrum · AngularJS

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
> Kept track of inventory and placed necessary order (Reduced the food cost by nearly 50%).
> Managed employees and made their schedule.
> Prepared employee's weekly pay-stub, and wrote and submitted weekly reports to the Subway Headquarters.

positions.title: Computer Lab Consultant
positions.description:
> Fixed lab printers, computer software and network issues.
> Kept track of student population within the lab.
> Logged students in and out of the study room within the lab.
> Logged university examination papers in and out of the exam logging system managed by the UCiT department.
